title: Heart-rate variability from an ECG
line: R peaks, beat-to-beat intervals, SDNN and RMSSD.
description: Heart-rate variability from two minutes of ECG: find the R peaks, take the beat-to-beat intervals, and compute SDNN and RMSSD. Breathing at 15 a minute modulates the rate.
